PaperReview.title: PaperReview
PaperReview.description: A structured adversarial peer review dossier for an academic journal manuscript generated via the multi-stage Reviewer2 & PhD-Skills pipeline.

title.description: Title of the reviewed academic manuscript

venueOrCitation.description: Journal, conference venue, DOI, or full citation string

isEmpirical.description: Whether the paper contains empirical data/experiments

credibilityScore.description: Overall methodological credibility score from 0 to 100

abstractSummary.description: Stage 00b clean summary of the manuscript abstract and central thesis

researchQuestion.description: Primary research question and identification strategy

keyMethodology.description: Summary of core empirical or theoretical methodology

blueTeamVerification.description: Stage 02-03 Blue Team defense, numerical verification, and surviving issues

mathAuditReport.description: Stage 01e-01fd equation proofread, LaTeX notation check, and derivation audit

codeAuditReport.description: Stage 01i-01n & X-Ray code reproducibility and data leakage audit

editorNote.description: Stage 08b Editor's synthesis note and decision rationale

copyeditSuggestions.description: Stage 09c author-facing copyediting, clarity, and structural improvements

reviewerQuestions.description: Anticipated Reviewer 2 questions and suggested ablation defenses

formattedDossier.description: Stage 10 plain-text assembled report in IS IT CREDIBLE? / reviewer2 format

bookmarked.description: Whether the user has starred/bookmarked this review

personalNotes.description: User's private referee or reading notes on the manuscript

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Per-user subcollection of critical journal paper reviews and adversarial audit dossiers.
